title: PHP security update
summary: Updates the Docker image to PHP 8.3.36 to fix two critical PHP vulnerabilities.
highlights: PHP 8.3.36 fixes CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, which can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
Update and recreate your Docker container to use the patched runtime. Installations running PHP directly need to update PHP separately.
